notes.title: Update 3 NOW LIVE (Controller Support added)
notes.content:
_Partially controller support added (Main menu still needs mouse. We are still working on it. Gameplay menu and gameplay are supported now). We've gotta admit that playing this game with a controller is a whole different experience. It just feels great.

_You can now shoot and walk back in the same time (simply hold space bar or A on the controller while using move keys and shoot key)
_Added more useful tips. 
_Reduced CEP (combat effective points) for some weapons so they can be purchased earlier
_removed Connection Status: Disconnected
_Game now pauses after hitting ESC or Start (controller)
_Balanced some gameplays

We will submit trading cards, badges, backgrounds, emoticons this weekend. Hopefully they will be available early next week.

Please continue to help us by providing helpful feedbacks in Bug Reports forum. We have always appreciated  your valuable supports :)

notes.title: Update 2 live (controller support delayed)
notes.content:
Make tanks deadlier
Fix some random spawn bugs
Boss fights' balancing
Fix some graphical errors
Add graphic setting options
Adding tips
Some general bugs

Note: due to the fact we just got to test  with a controller today, it was more complicated than we thought. So we have to delay it to the 3rd update. We are also working on trading cards, badges, and other goodies.

Stay tuned :)

notes.title: Day 1 update coming
notes.content:
We will have an update coming real soon

Fixes:

Some graphical problems
Some sound problems
Tanks damage changed
Bosses' fixes
Dialog got mixed up in the story line
other bugs

Due to the lack of experiences and proper testings for network, we may run into some connection problem in the release. Please share your experiences with us in the bug reports and we will continue to work on it.

This is the first major game for us with complex mechanics. Probably small for many developers but it is big for our current team. 

Any constructive feedbacks are greatly appreciated
